notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello Smithers!

Christmas is over, and it’s time for some spring-cleaning!
We’ve cleaned up some left over Christmas decorations, as well as some bugs. Hope you have a wonderful 2025! 

If you happen to run into any issues after installing this latest patch, please contact support@fasttravelgames.com and submit a full bug report to help us solve your problem. Thank you for playing BlackForge: A Smithing Adventure!



[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Wood texture artifacts fixed
[*] Removed weapon pictures from quests
[*] This mechanic still feels unpolished and didn’t give much, so removing it will clean up the visual clutter from the quest board
[*] Materials could be returned on another materials container
[*] Not that bad, but metal would not refill if removed in this way.
[*] Removed Christmas decorations
[*] Some were not removed automatically
[*] Removed Christmas trinket from shop
[*] This was not supposed to be buyable, only attained from quests
[*] Fixed a unbreakable metal bug
[/list]


[b]Known issues[/b]
[list]
[*] If you exit the forge as the merchant drops the cart, his IK might not reset correctly, leading to a visual bug. Not game breaking & very unlikely
[/list]

notes.title: Christmas Update 🎄❄️
notes.content:
Hello Smithers!

Christmas has come to BlackForge this holiday season! 

Explore the new cozy, snowy forge, and get some new trinkets as you puzzle your way through the seasonal quests! Make sure to take a break and sip on a nice cup of chocolate 😄☕

If you happen to run into any issues after installing this latest patch, please contact [b]support@fasttravelgames.com[/b] and submit a full bug report to help us solve your problem. Thank you for playing BlackForge: A Smithing Adventure!

[h3][b]Christmas[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The forge has received a Christmas Visual overhaul! Filled with snow and some new cozy interactions!
[*] Snowballs
[*] New minor trinket 👀
[*] New Seasonal missions. These are the Red ones that appear after you’ve unlocked wrapping!
[*] Swedish Julbock has been added, take good care of him!
[*] CANDY!
[*] Chocolate ☕
[/list]

[h3][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Major trinket VFX should now apply properly
[*] Engraving now erases properly
[*] Minor fixes on horses running in vista (Keep your eyes out)

[*] Adjusted the wrapper width slider, was finicky to pick up before

notes.title: Patch 5# - Sandbox update / Major Update
notes.content:
Hello Blacksmith!

We have heard your wishes, it is time for the [b]SANDBOX UPDATE[/b]!

This mode lets you dive straight into all the wonderful trinkets, tools, and materials the game offers! (So some spoilers will be present)
We recommend you play the main game to understand the smithing progress and tools before jumping into the sandbox mode.

Together with the new game mode, multiple save slots have been added! 
This allows you to have different saves, switch between save slots, see your current progression as well as delete saves to start a new game! 

Oh, and we have decorated the upstairs area, now you’ve got a new cozy living area to explore. I wonder what those rolls do? 🤔🎵

If you happen to run into any issues after installing this latest patch, please contact [b]support@fasttravelgames.com[/b] and submit a full bug report to help us solve your problem. Thank you for playing BlackForge: A Smithing Adventure!

[h2]NEW STUFF[/h2]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Sandbox mode added
[*] Save slots added
[*] Music box added upstairs
[*] Tools can be recalled back to their original position.
[*] Quest letters can be placed on the board next to the map
[*] A separate save game button is added by the exit gate.
[/list]

[b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved visual feedback on metal shapes
[*] Upstairs got a new fresh look!
[*] Chains wrapper got new visuals
[*] Quest letters now show a little picture of the weapon placed in it.
[*] The Merchant now brings news posters in his cart! 
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*] Multiple music tracks are added to the game!
[/list]

[h2]BUGFIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gameplay
[*] Multiple minor bugs resolved
[*] Haptics now works properly!
[*] The hammer and grinder have been tweaked and balanced.
[*] Metal shaping balanced 
[/list]

[b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] The bag of holding changes size accordingly when filling or emptying. 
[/list]

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]
[list]
[*] The barter sign is still NOT smackable :(
[*] Wood resources do not visually update accordingly when emptying the barter bag - pulling the lever updates the visual to show the actual amount.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 3# - Quest letters stop appearing
notes.content:
Hey there, Blacksmith!

This Hotfix is resolving an issue where The Merchant stops giving the player new quest letters.

This issue occurred if the game is closed right after The Merchant leaves the forge after completing the metal tutorial. 

If your current save is soft locked, you will need to ring the bell so The Merchant leaves and comes back again. 

“If stuck, no more stuck if update” - Devs

If you still run into issues, please contact [b]support@fasttravelgames.com[/b] and submit a full bug report to help us solve your issue, or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/p5nnCQPcxe]Discord[/url] community. 

Thank you for playing BlackForge: A Smithing Adventure!

notes.title: Patch 4 - Balance & Bug Fixes Update

Besides that, this patch focused on maximizing the coziness. So walk outside to the backyard, smell the flowers, and gaze out into the vast world of BlackForge. Be aware of your surroundings and you might see one of the many wild animals roaming around.

notes.title: Hotfix 2# - Crashes on Start-up
notes.content:
Hey there, Blacksmith!

This Hotfix follows up the multiple crashes on start-up after our Quality of life patch (ironic isn’t it 😅).

We believe to have hunted down the cause of this issue together with the issue of the game crashing more or less consistently after a playtime of about 30 minutes. We are continuously working on preventing crashes.

If you still run into issues with consistent crashes after updating, please contact [b]support@fasttravelgames.com[/b] and submit a full bug report to help us solve your issue, or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/p5nnCQPcxe]Discord[/url] community.

That is all for now, see you at the forge ⚒️.

Thank you for playing BlackForge: A Smithing Adventure!

notes.title: Patch 3# - Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Blacksmith![/h1]

For the third patch, our focus has been on cleaning up the forge a bit, it sure gets messy as one walks around and throws materials and trinkets on the ground! Subtitles settings have also been added, so you can move the text box to a preferred placement. Skipping dialogue has also made its way to the forge!

One major issue we hammered down in this patch is players getting blocked from creating more metal ingots! This happens when the forge has too many pieces of metal lying around. We now have a “Clean forge” button available, wiping the entire forge from loose metal ingots, wood pieces, props and resources! [i](button is found on the backside of the furnace)[/i]

Multiple smithers have asked for a trash can to dump unwanted creations and materials. Let us introduce the incinerator! Simply open the hatch and dump whatever you’d like and pull the lever. Your resources will return to their containers!

If you happen to run into any issues after installing this latest patch, please contact support@fasttravelgames.com and submit a full bug report to help us solve your issue. Thank you for playing BlackForge: A Smithing Adventure!

[h2]BUGFIXES[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pliers now snap wood to hand 
[*] Subtitles settings has been added to the settings board
[*] Right thumbstick now turn off / on subtitles
[*] “B” button skips forward in dialogue
[*] Resources bought from barter now spawns in the forge correctly
[*] Resources from barter and quests now saves correctly
[*] Metal sharpness has been rebalanced
[*] Dummy feedback has been balanced
[*] “Clean forge” button has been added on the backside of the furnace
[*] Incinerator has been added next to the ore supply! NOTE: Tutorial for this is on its way but the functionality of it is there right from the beginning.
[*] Buyable and tradable resources value has been balanced.
[/list]
[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Horseshoe mini-game stick has a collider! Good luck!
[*] Pinewood texture brightness is bumped up, making it easier to see when turning
[*] New icon for when subtitles is turned off
[*] New icon for skipping dialogue
[*] Ghost nail during dewelding tutorial now stops glowing after you hit it
[*] Visual feedback from hitting the dummy is more distinct with different colors
[/list]
[h3]Known issues:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Using “Clean forge” button might make the Smithers Hammer spawn by the ore supply early in the game (for some goddang reason 🙁)
[*] Text box saying “Hello Blacksmith” might appear during splash screen
[*] When using the “clean forge” button, completed quests or retries quests on the questboard will appear inside the questboard, note that they are STILL there so you can grab them. Restarting the game will make them spawn as intended on the board.
[*] Resources used to barter with might reappear in the backyard after exiting the game
[*] Haptics might not work properly
[*] Barter sign is still NOT smackable :(
[*] Wood resources do not visually update accordingly when emptying the barter bag - pulling the lever updates the visual to show actual amount.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2# - Crashes and tutorial fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Blacksmith![/h1]

For the second Patch, we have dived into the crash site and gotten loose from the grip of tutorials hindering us from progressing!

This patch is focused on fixing the annoying and blocking bugs that multiple Smithers encountered. 
We got a deal with the Merchant to stop staring at us and giving the silent treatment during tutorials.
We also bumped up the light so we can actually see our lovely (or hideous) creations more clearly and added some invisible beams to help the forge from crashing.

If you happen to run into any issues after installing this latest patch, please contact [b]support@fasttravelgames.com[/b] and submit a full bug report to help us solve your issue. Thank you for playing BlackForge: A Smithing Adventure!

notes.title: Patch #1 - 3D Printing & Bug Fixes

Also we know that some of you have been affected by a very nasty bug that is wiping save data. We're very sorry to those of you that have encountered this! Rest assured this is now fixed!

notes.content:
Hey there, blacksmiths! 

Today's the day. We're very proud to say that BlackForge: A Smithing Adventure is now available on SteamVR! We're so excited to welcome you into our wonderful world of smithing and let the community loose on their own creations. 

Check out our brand-new launch trailer right here:

[previewyoutube=Q1hzHCjDqBo;full][/previewyoutube]

Just a heads up - we're currently planning a day 4 patch that will include some tweaks and fixes and also add 3D printing support on PC! We'll have more information on that soon so keep an eye out!

BlackForge has been a really special project for us and we can't wait to see what you start making. Please do share your work on social channels and make sure to tag us!

For now, here are the[b] Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]Trees in the backyard changes models when walking around the backyard
[*]Request can sometimes appear on the back of the quest board
[*]Request can sometimes float a few inches away from the quest board
[*]Merchant animation for bartering can make him float in the air when the player enters a tutorial.
[*]Merchant voiceline missing in barter when explaining masking tool
[*]Lip sync for Merchant (after metal tutorial) and heroes is missing
[*]Horseshoe mini game stick has no collider
[*]A weapon with wood welded to it can sometimes be completely destroyed if tossed into the fire.
[*]Volume settings slider is not possible to go from 0 to 100
[*]Rocks in the backyard and closest to the forge has no colliders
[*]Merchants hammer has the wrong material on his hip
[*]Haptics might not work properly
[*]Barter sign requires player to double tap the first time and is flipped the wrong way 
[*]Barter sign is NOT smackable :(
[*]If items or objects accidentally fall through the ground,they will not respawn back to ground level. This can occur if a player accidentally adds force by smacking something down to the ground.
[*]Sometimes when hammering a hot piece of metal, the piece can get bugged out
[*]It is possible to complete a tutorial request several times if the game restarts at specific times. This issue results in the player getting more reputation than they should have, skipping crucial tutorial steps further down the line. Locking the player from obtaining Copper ore and therefore cannot complete the “bear population” quest
[*]Barter tutorial can be locked IF the tutorial is rushed through and the player skips steps![/list]
[b]PC Specific[/b]

[list]
[*]Mouse and keyboard input is enabled for movement while in VR
[/list]
That's all from us. Now get smithing!

notes.title: Dev blog update 6# - Time to B-B-B-Barter!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Smithers![/h1]
As you make stuff in your forge, you might need some extra materials. You will get materials during quests but you can also barter with the Merchant as he visits you! 

[h2]How does it work?​[/h2]
Take note that this system is still work in progress so stuff might change along the way. But this is what we got right now: 

[h2]Bag of Holding[/h2]
As you work you will eventually be introduced to something we call “the bag of holding”, (creative name right, not obvious of its purpose at all) and it pretty much work as any inventory in most games. Stuff your unwanted stuff in it and walk up to the Merchant as he has opened his shop to you!

You will know of he has opened shop as he climbs into his cart and swings the doors open! We got some WIP animation clip here: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014947/573030239f869a0da1a6359704af6e9d95d2f96a.gif[/img]


[h2]Valuating Scale[/h2]
Choose want you would like to get from him by pointing at the item and he will place it on a scale, this is where “the bag of holding” comes in. You place it on the corresponding scale bowl and the scale will valuate your item(s) in the bag with the item from the Merchant. 

If the scale is tilted towards the item from the Merchant you need to add stuff on your side of the scale to match its value.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014947/eb4be1a58fc104099f8cf3978df7ed3e142dc180.gif[/img]
If your items corresponds well with the shifting of the scale, you’re good to go!
As noted earlier, this is still in testing for us so we might iterate on it. But this is at least the general idea for the purpose of the Barter System!

[i]"Working with physics based games are so much fun!"[/i] - the day before implementing the valuating scale
[i]Sincerely, Me with instant regret[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014947/c286e72d92c2b6819e20f4a2843705f66011dffc.gif[/img]

Feel free to follow us on our other socials!
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@manabrigade]Tiktok[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/BlackforgeVR]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.manabrigade.com]Website[/url]

[b]Cheerios![/b]
Julia at ManaBrigade

notes.title: Dev blog update 4# - Let's talk about grip
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Smithers![/h1]
As a blacksmith creating weapons of all kind of needs, some of them are bound to be in need of some extra grip. Let us introduce Leather wrapping! 

[h2]Wrap around and around​[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014947/aff27c9856adb99ff78c03cdb26752c662c25bd0.gif[/img]
As you craft different type of weapons, you will have different type of wrapping at hand as the world of BlackForge expands throughout your progression. Depending on the weapons need for grip you can choose the fitting wrapping. Be aware that some materials for wrapping excel in other areas than grip.

You can also change the width of the wrapping to fit your need. You’re not limited by a set thickness. 

[h2]Add and remove wrapping
[/h2]
Did you use the wrong wrapping? or just want to change the placing? 
Don’t worry! You can simply remove the wrapping just by going the opposite direction with your hands. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014947/b691a87283655ecbbc25da635701cdfb536dfe22.gif[/img]
This is also doable after you let go of the wrapping and come back later to redo it.


The wrapping also stays on save (woohooo) this will probably not ever happen to you playing BUT dayum did we have some struggle with this. As we tested this tool, the leather wrap never stayed after we stop playtesting and started playing again. So we got it all working and looking good, only to loose the entire thing when we pressed play again.


Feel free to follow us on our other socials!

Twitter
Website

Julia at ManaBrigade

notes.title: Dev blog update 2# - Adding "Black Magic"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Smithers![/h1]

 We got some cool black magic to show you! Or in more familiar term, Visual effects (VFX for short)
Our Magister of black Magic (or just Isac for short) have created some really cool looking effects for some of our stations in BlackForgeVR.

[h1]Planning Station[/h1]
This station is where you begin your thinking work. Putting the quest given from the travelling Merchant and place it on the convenient square slot. AND NOW, BEHOLD THE MAGICAL SPHERE APPEARING!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014947/5972b836bad040a2e70101f7ba4a29a8600e9788.gif[/img]

As you create the weapon desired in the quest, you place it in the sphere. Delivering finished quests is done by returning them to the province board outside your forge.

We are however going to iterate on this station for the future. Reading text in VR is a struggle, so we are working on adding something that will zoom in on the quest description after it’s placed in the slot. Currently cooking up some delicious concept art atm so we’ll get back later on that!

[h1]Ore smelter[/h1]
We got some sweet VFX for the ore smelter aswell! As you start pouring ore in the container, your companion, the Fire Spirit will start cuddling it to heat it up and you can quickly see the bubbles from the smelted ore. As you pour more ore, the bubbles rises. When you are satisfied with the amount, pour the melted ore and be MESMERIZED by the SATYSFYING flow of metal pouring out into the mould. Pick up your metal and get hammering! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014947/5cc72b5e4f42d7d185c46b71b7ceeb0f5bfda4a7.gif[/img]
